qa.q: How does the fitting room work?
qa.a: Pick any shirt and any denim, choose your size, then drag the mannequin to turn it and zoom in on the collar, the buttons and the stitching. Tap a mannequin on the floor to see its outfit.

qa.q: How do I change the language?
qa.a: Tap EN / ES at the top of the page to switch between English and Spanish.
